reason: Every boundary bit already has its register in RTL: the multirate bridges write their serial slots straight from vmr_cmd/su_wq and drive su_rr from serial_rr registers; the LG tap registers its local/far/near inputs at the pins and its mux/output stage; the inject slots capture inj_rd/inj_addr on pg_clk. ij_*/pg_fault are decoded from those registers (timed as the related 4:3 crossing into the slice S band). Wrapper flops would add edges to the fixed VM calendar (10/7) and the slice offsets of the lockstep bench.
